title: _require_governance_paper_ready uses default limit=500, possibly truncating validation history for stability gate
description: paper-v2 4-layer audit (commit fca9d69, doc docs/cross_tool/20260511_paper_v2_REVIEW_codex_governance_audit.md §6) found StrategyPackage with >500 validation runs reaching enable_paper has stability gate truncated. _require_governance_paper_ready called governance_eligibility without explicit limit, defaulting to 500. Codex fix (commit 1462099) introduces PAPER_READY_GOVERNANCE_LIMIT = 10_000 constant and passes limit=PAPER_READY_GOVERNANCE_LIMIT to governance_eligibility call. 22 + 20 + 12 = 54 strategy_package/model_registry/governance tests pass.

preconditions: StrategyPackage exists with >500 historical validation runs

required_verification: Codex strategy_package + model_registry + governance tests 54 passed
closure_requirements: Codex round-1 fix commit 1462099 reviewed by Claude strategy session (verified)
Sprint Stage 6 baseline runs without governance stability false-positive/negative
Decision: bump limit to 10K accepted; alternative (manifest_sha256 SQL-side filter) deferred
